question_text: Provide a brief description of the application/service, its purpose, and the key functionalities it offers.
What type of service does the vendor provide? (e.g., SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, On-Premises, Hybrid)
Where is the application hosted? (e.g., vendor-managed cloud, specific hyperscaler, on-premises, hybrid)
Which hyperscaler or cloud provider is used, if applicable? (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud)
What categories of data will the application process or store? (e.g., PII, financial data, health data, credentials, internal business data)
In which geographic region(s) will data be stored and processed? Please specify countries or regions.
Does the vendor have a documented data retention and deletion policy? If yes, please describe the retention periods and deletion procedures.
Does the application transfer data to third parties or sub-processors? If yes, identify them and describe the data shared.
Provide a high-level architecture diagram of the application, including all major components, integrations, and data flows.
Provide a network diagram illustrating how the application connects to Albatha's environment, internet, and any third-party services.
Describe the disaster recovery (DR) strategy for the application. What is the Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO)?
Where is the disaster recovery site located? Is it in a different geographic region from the primary site?
Describe the authentication mechanisms supported by the application. (e.g., username/password, SSO, SAML, OAuth, MFA)
Does the application support Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)? Is MFA enforced or optional?
Does the application support integration with Albatha's Active Directory or Azure AD for Single Sign-On (SSO)?
Describe the role-based access control (RBAC) model. How are user roles and permissions managed?
How is privileged access (admin accounts) managed and controlled? Are privileged sessions monitored and logged?
What encryption standard is used for data at rest? Specify the algorithm and key length (e.g., AES-256).
What encryption standard is used for data in transit? (e.g., TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3) Are older protocols such as SSL, TLS 1.0, or TLS 1.1 disabled?
How are encryption keys managed? Who holds the keys — the vendor, a third party, or the customer? Describe the key rotation policy.
Has the application undergone a third-party penetration test within the last 12 months? If yes, please provide the date and a summary of findings and remediation status.
Does the vendor have a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty programme?
How does the vendor manage software dependencies and third-party libraries? Is software composition analysis (SCA) performed?
What is the vendor's patch management process? How quickly are critical security patches applied?
What security certifications and compliance frameworks does the vendor hold? (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI-DSS, CSA STAR) Please provide certification dates and scope.
Is the application compliant with relevant data protection regulations applicable to Albatha's operating regions? (e.g., PDPL, GDPR, UAE Data Protection Law)
Does the vendor have a documented Incident Response Plan (IRP)? How will Albatha be notified in the event of a security breach affecting Albatha data?
What is the vendor's breach notification timeline? Will Albatha be notified within 72 hours of a confirmed breach, in line with regulatory requirements?
What audit logging capabilities does the application provide? What events are logged (e.g., login attempts, data access, configuration changes)?
How long are logs retained? Can logs be exported to Albatha's SIEM or security monitoring platform?
Describe the AI/ML model(s) used in this application. Are these proprietary models, third-party models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), or open-source models?
Is Albatha data (inputs, prompts, or outputs) used to train, fine-tune, or improve the AI model? If yes, describe the process and how consent is obtained.
Where are prompts, inputs, and AI-generated outputs stored? How long are they retained, and who can access them?
Does the application use Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) or connect the AI model to internal data sources? If yes, describe what data sources are accessed and how access is controlled.
Is there any data isolation between different customers or tenants in the AI layer? Describe how customer data is segregated within the AI pipeline.
What measures are in place to prevent prompt injection attacks? Has the application been tested specifically for prompt injection vulnerabilities?
What controls exist to prevent the AI model from generating harmful, biased, or inappropriate outputs? Describe any content filtering or output moderation mechanisms.
Is there a human-in-the-loop review process for high-risk AI-generated outputs or decisions? If so, describe when and how human oversight is applied.
Does the vendor have an AI governance framework or responsible AI policy? Please provide a summary or link to the policy.
How are AI model updates and version changes managed? Is Albatha notified of significant model changes that may affect behaviour or outputs?
Can the AI model's decisions or outputs be explained or audited? What level of explainability is available to Albatha administrators?
Are AI interactions logged for audit purposes? How long are AI interaction logs retained and who can access them?
Has the AI component of the application undergone any specific AI security assessment or red-teaming exercise? If yes, please provide details.
